description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Upper Transmission Shifter Case Kit
Includes Large Locating Bolt:
Head – 12mm Hex
Thread – 10mm x 1.25 Fine
Shaft – 19mm L x 8mm Dia.
* NOTE: Early 1990 models use the Older 1986™ style Shift Lever that has the small Locating Bolt Slot. That Shift Lever is no longer made by Suzuki. To replace, please buy the Full Replacement Kit
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Transmission Shift Lever Upper Case
Qty 1 – Locating Bolt & Washer
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990* – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1990* – 1995 All Models
